Flips when mapWine reads either column (owed item 5, the WineProfile contract). If mapWine is renamed the verify passes on purpose, so the row reads STALE and someone re-reads it [Resolved 2026-09-29, found STALE when #431 was merged into the batch PR: mapWine reads wine_structure (and emits a structure block) since #434, 92ea9cecc, 2026-09-22. The verify is unchanged; it holds.]

mapWine maps tastingNotes from row.tasting_notes, a column production master_wine_library does not have (information_schema: 0 columns named tasting_notes, 2026-09-18), and description from producer_story, which is null on all 3,589 live rows; so both fields are always absent on the wire (wine-intelligence-foundations.md §2 item 5). Flips when row.tasting_notes is no longer read (owed item 3)

The insight generator's inventory slice (insight-generator.service.ts loadBundle) embeds only master_wine_library(primary_type) and never reads it afterwards, and DataRequirement has no library source, so none of the 573 catalogued insight types takes a library feature today (wine-intelligence-foundations.md §6). Flips when that embed selects more than primary_type or is replaced (owed item 13)

No deploy config in the repo starts a Celery worker or beat: the orchestrator Dockerfile CMD is uvicorn only, .railway/railway.ts declares four services none of which runs celery, services/agent-orchestrator/railway.toml sets no start command, docker-compose.yml and docker-compose.override.yml have no celery service. So every beat entry in services/agent-orchestrator/jobs/celery_app.py is code only; production shows none of the wine jobs ever wrote (wine-intelligence-foundations.md §3). Flips when any of these files declares a celery worker or beat; if the founder instead hosts enrichment on gateway @Cron (fork F1), retire this row. A service configured only in the Railway dashboard, or a worker declared in a file not listed here (a new Procfile or a second service file), is invisible to this verify; production writes are the other witness. Widened 2026-09-18 by adversarial review after a worker added to docker-compose.override.yml left the row holding

Which house's rows belong in the list is OD-102 and not this row. Flips when the file names either column; a fix through a live-only view would not flip it, so retire the row by hand in that case
